import os
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.stats as sps
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter, CoxPHFitter
from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

BASE          = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
OUT_DIR       = os.path.join(BASE, "manuscript_final_code", "outputs")
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

DAYS_PER_MONTH = 30.44
ID_COLS = ["Bundling.ID", "GalaxyID"]


def fmt_p(p):
    if p is None or (isinstance(p, float) and np.isnan(p)):
        return ""
    return "<0.001" if p < 0.001 else f"{p:.3f}"


def hide_spines(ax):
    for s in ("top", "right"):
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)


def simplify_stage(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return np.nan
    s = str(s).strip()
    if s.startswith("IV") or s == "Mts/Rec":
        return 4
    if s.startswith("III"):
        return 3
    if s.startswith("II"):
        return 2
    if s.startswith("I"):
        return 1
    return np.nan


def stage_dummies(stage_series, prefix="stage"):
    STAGE_I_MERGE_MIN = 10
    s_num = pd.to_numeric(stage_series, errors="coerce")
    if 0 < int((s_num == 1).sum()) < STAGE_I_MERGE_MIN:
        stage_series = s_num.replace({1: 2})
    s = stage_series.dropna().astype(int)
    if s.nunique() < 2:
        return pd.DataFrame(index=stage_series.index)
    dd = pd.get_dummies(stage_series.astype("Int64"), prefix=prefix).astype(float)
    ref_col = sorted(dd.columns, key=lambda c: int(c.split("_")[-1]))[0]
    return dd.drop(columns=[ref_col])


def _pt_grp(x):
    s = str(x)
    if s.startswith("pT4"):
        return "T4"
    for k in ("pT1", "pT2", "pT3"):
        if s.startswith(k):
            return k[1:]
    return np.nan


def _pn_grp(x):
    s = str(x)
    for k in ("pN0", "pN1", "pN2"):
        if s.startswith(k):
            return k[1:]
    return np.nan


def _lvi(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return np.nan
    s = str(x)
    return "Present" if ("Ly1" in s or "V1" in s) else "Absent"


def _pni(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return np.nan
    s = str(x)
    if s.startswith("Pn1"):
        return "Present"
    if s.startswith("Pn0"):
        return "Absent"
    return np.nan


def derive_baseline(m, mtm_col):
    m = m.copy()
    m["age"] = pd.to_numeric(m["Age"], errors="coerce")
    m["age_grp"] = pd.cut(m["age"], [-np.inf, 65, 75, np.inf],
                          labels=["<65", "65\u201374", "\u226575"], right=False)
    m["sex"] = m["Sex"]
    ecog_n = pd.to_numeric(m["ECOG"], errors="coerce")
    m["ecog"] = np.where(ecog_n >= 1, "\u22651", "0")
    m.loc[ecog_n.isna(), "ecog"] = np.nan
    m["stage"] = m["stage_num"].map({1: "I", 2: "II", 3: "III", 4: "IV"})
    m["pT_grp"] = m["pT"].apply(_pt_grp)
    m["pN_grp"] = m["pN"].apply(_pn_grp)
    m["sidedness"] = m["LocationGrpA"].replace("Unknown", np.nan)
    m["primary"]   = m["LocationGrpB"]
    m["msi"]  = m["msi_call"].map({"MSS": "MSS", "MSI-High": "MSI-H"})
    m["ras"]  = m["ras_call"].map({"WT": "Negative", "MUT": "Positive"})
    m["braf"] = m["braf_call"].map({"WT": "Negative", "MUT": "Positive"})
    m["lvi"] = m["p_LVI"].apply(_lvi)
    m["pni"] = m["p_PNI"].apply(_pni)
    m["mrd"] = np.where(m["mrd_pos"], "Positive", "Negative")
    mtm = pd.to_numeric(m[mtm_col], errors="coerce")
    m["mrd_mtm_pos"] = np.where(m["mrd_pos"], mtm, np.nan)
    m["fu_months"] = pd.to_numeric(m["p_drelOS"], errors="coerce") / DAYS_PER_MONTH
    m["os_evt"] = pd.to_numeric(m["p_evtOS"], errors="coerce")
    return m


def _cont_p(samples):
    samples = [x for x in samples if len(x) > 0]
    if len(samples) < 2:
        return np.nan
    try:
        if len(samples) == 2:
            return sps.mannwhitneyu(samples[0], samples[1], alternative="two-sided").pvalue
        return sps.kruskal(*samples).pvalue
    except Exception:
        return np.nan


def _cat_p(tab):
    if tab.shape[0] < 2 or tab.shape[1] < 2 or tab.values.sum() == 0:
        return np.nan
    try:
        if tab.shape == (2, 2):
            return sps.fisher_exact(tab.values)[1]
        return sps.chi2_contingency(tab.values)[1]
    except Exception:
        return np.nan


def _cont_stat(sr, dec=0):
    sr = sr.dropna()
    if sr.empty:
        return ""
    return f"{sr.median():.{dec}f} [{sr.quantile(.25):.{dec}f}\u2013{sr.quantile(.75):.{dec}f}]"


def _cont_row(rows, cols, groups, label, col, dec=0, show_p=True):
    r = {"Characteristic": label}
    for name, gdf in cols:
        r[name] = _cont_stat(gdf[col], dec)
    r["p"] = fmt_p(_cont_p([gdf[col].dropna().values for gdf in groups])) if show_p else "\u2013"
    rows.append(r)


def _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, label, col, order, show_missing=True):
    rows.append({"Characteristic": label, **{c[0]: "" for c in cols}, "p": ""})
    header_idx = len(rows) - 1
    for lv in order:
        r = {"Characteristic": f"  {lv}"}
        for name, gdf in cols:
            n_tot = len(gdf)
            n_lv = int((gdf[col] == lv).sum())
            r[name] = f"{n_lv} ({100*n_lv/n_tot:.1f}%)" if n_tot else "0"
        r["p"] = ""
        rows.append(r)
    tab = pd.DataFrame({i: groups[i][col].value_counts() for i in range(len(groups))}).fillna(0)
    tab = tab.loc[[lv for lv in order if lv in tab.index]]
    rows[header_idx]["p"] = fmt_p(_cat_p(tab))
    if show_missing:
        r = {"Characteristic": "  Missing"}
        for name, gdf in cols:
            n_tot = len(gdf)
            n_miss = int(gdf[col].isna().sum())
            r[name] = f"{n_miss} ({100*n_miss/n_tot:.1f}%)" if n_tot else "0"
        r["p"] = ""
        rows.append(r)


def build_demographics_table(cols, groups, include_mrd_row):
    rows = []
    rows.append({"Characteristic": "N", **{name: f"{len(gdf):,}" for name, gdf in cols}, "p": ""})
    _cont_row(rows, cols, groups, "Follow-up time in months, median [IQR]", "fu_months", dec=1, show_p=False)
    if include_mrd_row:
        _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "MRD-window ctDNA status", "mrd",
                  order=["Negative", "Positive"], show_missing=False)
    _cont_row(rows, cols, groups, "Age, median [IQR], y", "age")
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Age group", "age_grp",
              order=["<65", "65\u201374", "\u226575"], show_missing=False)
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Sex", "sex", order=["Female", "Male"], show_missing=False)
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "ECOG performance status", "ecog", order=["0", "\u22651"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Pathologic stage", "stage", order=["I", "II", "III", "IV"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Primary tumor (pT)", "pT_grp", order=["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Nodal status (pN)", "pN_grp", order=["N0", "N1", "N2"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Tumor sidedness", "sidedness",
              order=["Left-sided colon", "Right-sided colon"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Primary site", "primary", order=["Colon", "Rectum"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "MMR/MSI status", "msi", order=["MSS", "MSI-H"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "RAS", "ras", order=["Negative", "Positive"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "BRAF", "braf", order=["Negative", "Positive"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Lymphovascular invasion", "lvi", order=["Absent", "Present"])
    _cat_rows(rows, cols, groups, "Perineural invasion", "pni", order=["Absent", "Present"])
    _cont_row(rows, cols, groups, "MRD-window MTM among MRD+, median [IQR]", "mrd_mtm_pos", dec=2)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)[["Characteristic"] + [c[0] for c in cols] + ["p"]]


def fit_km(t, e, label=""):
    return KaplanMeierFitter(label=label).fit(t, event_observed=e)


def draw_risk_table(risk_ax, strata, xticks, xlim, show_xaxis=True, xlabel=None,
                    fontsize=7.5, title="No. at risk"):
    n = len(strata)
    risk_ax.set_xlim(xlim)
    risk_ax.set_ylim(0, n)
    for i, (label, color, t) in enumerate(strata):
        y = n - i - 0.5
        tarr = np.asarray([x for x in t if np.isfinite(x)], float)
        for xt in xticks:
            risk_ax.text(xt, y, str(int(np.sum(tarr >= xt))),
                         ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fontsize, color="#222222")
    risk_ax.set_yticks([n - i - 0.5 for i in range(n)])
    risk_ax.set_yticklabels([s[0] for s in strata], fontsize=fontsize)
    for tick, (label, color, t) in zip(risk_ax.get_yticklabels(), strata):
        tick.set_color(color)
    risk_ax.set_xticks(xticks)
    if show_xaxis:
        risk_ax.set_xticklabels([str(int(x)) for x in xticks], fontsize=fontsize + 0.5)
        if xlabel:
            risk_ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
    else:
        risk_ax.set_xticklabels([])
    risk_ax.tick_params(axis="both", length=0)
    for s in ("top", "right", "left", "bottom"):
        risk_ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    risk_ax.set_title(title, loc="left", fontsize=fontsize + 1, fontweight="bold", pad=3)


def draw_km_curve(ax, kmf, color, lw=2.2, ls="-", alpha=1.0, label=None):
    sf = kmf.survival_function_
    ax.step(np.array(sf.index), np.array(sf.iloc[:, 0]), where="post",
            color=color, lw=lw, ls=ls, alpha=alpha, solid_capstyle="butt",
            label=label)
    for c in kmf.durations[kmf.event_observed == 0]:
        try:
            ax.plot(c, float(kmf.predict(c)), "|", color=color, ms=7, mew=1.3, alpha=alpha)
        except Exception:
            pass


def landmark_frame(df, landmark_d, endpoint):
    dur_col = "dfs_days" if endpoint == "DFS" else "os_days"
    evt_col = "dfs_evt" if endpoint == "DFS" else "os_evt"
    d = df[df[dur_col].notna()].copy()
    d = d[d[dur_col] >= landmark_d].copy()
    d["_t"] = (d[dur_col] - landmark_d) / DAYS_PER_MONTH
    d["_e"] = pd.to_numeric(d[evt_col], errors="coerce").astype(int)
    same = (d["_t"] == 0) & (d["_e"] == 1)
    d.loc[same, "_t"] = 1.0 / DAYS_PER_MONTH
    return d


def landmark_cox_adjusted(d, present_arms, ref_key, covs=("stage", "age", "ecog", "mtm")):
    dd = d[d["arm"].isin(present_arms)].copy()
    if "mtm" in covs:
        dd["log_mtm"] = np.log1p(pd.to_numeric(dd["mrd_mtm"], errors="coerce"))
    req = []
    if "stage" in covs: req.append("stage_num")
    if "age" in covs:   req.append("age")
    if "ecog" in covs:  req.append("ecog_ge1")
    if "mtm" in covs:   req.append("log_mtm")
    dd = dd.dropna(subset=["_t", "_e"] + req).copy()

    parts = []
    if "stage" in covs: parts.append(stage_dummies(dd["stage_num"], prefix="stage"))
    if "age" in covs:   parts.append(dd[["age"]].astype(float))
    if "ecog" in covs:  parts.append(dd[["ecog_ge1"]].astype(float))
    if "mtm" in covs:   parts.append(dd[["log_mtm"]].astype(float))
    adj = pd.concat(parts, axis=1) if parts else pd.DataFrame(index=dd.index)

    dummies = pd.get_dummies(dd["arm"], prefix="g").astype(float)
    ref_col = f"g_{ref_key}"
    if ref_col in dummies.columns:
        dummies = dummies.drop(columns=[ref_col])
    n_arm = dd["arm"].value_counts().to_dict()
    ev_arm = dd.groupby("arm")["_e"].sum().to_dict()
    fit_df = pd.concat([dd[["_t", "_e"]].reset_index(drop=True),
                        dummies.reset_index(drop=True),
                        adj.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    results = {}
    for pen in (0.0, 0.1, 0.5):
        try:
            cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=pen).fit(fit_df, duration_col="_t", event_col="_e")
            for col in dummies.columns:
                lvl = col[2:]
                hr = float(np.exp(cph.params_[col]))
                lo = float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% lower-bound"]))
                hi = float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% upper-bound"]))
                p = float(cph.summary.loc[col, "p"])
                results[lvl] = (hr, lo, hi, p, pen > 0,
                                int(n_arm.get(lvl, 0)), int(ev_arm.get(lvl, 0)))
            return results
        except Exception:
            continue
    return results


def _km_area(t, e, tau):
    t = np.asarray(t, float); e = np.asarray(e, int)
    if len(t) == 0:
        return 0.0
    order = np.argsort(t, kind="mergesort")
    ts, es = t[order], e[order]
    n = len(ts)
    et = np.unique(ts[(es == 1) & (ts <= tau)])
    if len(et) == 0:
        return float(tau)
    nrisk = n - np.searchsorted(ts, et, side="left")
    ev_all = ts[es == 1]
    d = (np.searchsorted(ev_all, et, side="right")
         - np.searchsorted(ev_all, et, side="left"))
    S_steps = np.cumprod(1.0 - d / nrisk)
    Svals = np.concatenate([[1.0], S_steps])
    bounds = np.concatenate([[0.0], et, [tau]])
    seg = np.clip(bounds[1:], None, tau) - np.clip(bounds[:-1], None, tau)
    return float(np.sum(Svals * np.maximum(seg, 0.0)))


def _pseudo_rmst(t, e, tau):
    t = np.asarray(t, float); e = np.asarray(e, int); n = len(t)
    theta = _km_area(t, e, tau)
    ps = np.empty(n); keep = np.ones(n, bool)
    for i in range(n):
        keep[i] = False
        ps[i] = n * theta - (n - 1) * _km_area(t[keep], e[keep], tau)
        keep[i] = True
    return ps


def _design(dd, arms, ref_key, covs):
    order = [a for a in arms if a != ref_key]
    cols = [np.ones(len(dd))]
    for a in order:
        cols.append((dd["arm"].values == a).astype(float))
    if "stage" in covs:
        sd = stage_dummies(dd["stage_num"], prefix="stage")
        for c in sd.columns:
            cols.append(sd[c].values.astype(float))
    if "age" in covs:
        cols.append(dd["age"].values.astype(float))
    if "ecog" in covs:
        cols.append(dd["ecog_ge1"].values.astype(float))
    if "mtm" in covs:
        cols.append(np.log1p(dd["mrd_mtm"].values.astype(float)))
    return np.column_stack(cols), order


def adj_rmst_contrasts(d, arms, ref_key, covs, horizon):
    req = ["_t", "_e"] + (["stage_num"] if "stage" in covs else []) \
        + (["age"] if "age" in covs else []) + (["ecog_ge1"] if "ecog" in covs else []) \
        + (["mrd_mtm"] if "mtm" in covs else [])
    dd = d[d["arm"].isin(arms)].dropna(subset=req).reset_index(drop=True)
    y = _pseudo_rmst(dd["_t"].values, dd["_e"].values, horizon)
    X, order = _design(dd, arms, ref_key, covs)
    n, k = X.shape
    XtXinv = np.linalg.pinv(X.T @ X)
    beta = XtXinv @ (X.T @ y)
    resid = y - X @ beta
    meat = X.T @ (X * (resid ** 2)[:, None])
    scale = n / max(n - k, 1)
    cov = XtXinv @ meat @ XtXinv * scale
    se = np.sqrt(np.clip(np.diag(cov), 0, None))
    out = {}
    for i, a in enumerate(order):
        est = float(beta[1 + i]); s = float(se[1 + i])
        n_a = int((dd["arm"] == a).sum()); ev_a = int(dd.loc[dd["arm"] == a, "_e"].sum())
        if n_a < 8 or ev_a < 3 or s <= 0:
            out[a] = (est, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan)
        else:
            out[a] = (est, est - 1.96 * s, est + 1.96 * s, 2 * sps.norm.sf(abs(est) / s))
    return out


def _rmst_arm(t, e, horizon):
    t = np.asarray(t, float); e = np.asarray(e, int)
    ev_times = np.unique(t[e == 1]); ev_times = ev_times[ev_times <= horizon]
    segs, pt, S = [], 0.0, 1.0
    d_arr, n_arr, ct_arr = [], [], []
    for ut in ev_times:
        n_i = int(np.sum(t >= ut)); d_i = int(np.sum((t == ut) & (e == 1)))
        segs.append((pt, ut, S))
        S = S * (1 - d_i / n_i) if n_i > 0 else S
        pt = ut; ct_arr.append(ut); d_arr.append(d_i); n_arr.append(n_i)
    segs.append((pt, horizon, S))

    def area_from(a):
        tot = 0.0
        for s0, s1, sv in segs:
            lo, hi = max(s0, a), min(s1, horizon)
            if hi > lo:
                tot += sv * (hi - lo)
        return tot

    rmst = area_from(0.0); var = 0.0
    for k2, ct in enumerate(ct_arr):
        n_i, d_i = n_arr[k2], d_arr[k2]
        if d_i > 0 and n_i > d_i:
            A = area_from(ct); var += (A ** 2) * d_i / (n_i * (n_i - d_i))
    return float(rmst), float(var)


def rmst_difference(ref_t, ref_e, cmp_t, cmp_e, horizon):
    r_ref, v_ref = _rmst_arm(ref_t, ref_e, horizon)
    r_cmp, v_cmp = _rmst_arm(cmp_t, cmp_e, horizon)
    diff = r_cmp - r_ref
    if np.isnan(v_ref) or np.isnan(v_cmp) or (v_ref + v_cmp) <= 0:
        return diff, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
    se = np.sqrt(v_ref + v_cmp)
    return diff, diff - 1.96 * se, diff + 1.96 * se, 2 * sps.norm.sf(abs(diff) / se)


def mtm_hi_lo_cox(dsub):
    d = dsub.dropna(subset=["_t", "_e", "stage_num", "age", "ecog_ge1"]).copy()
    d["hi"] = (d["mtm_grp"] == "high").astype(float)
    lo_m = d[d["hi"] == 0]; hi_m = d[d["hi"] == 1]
    n_lo, n_hi = len(lo_m), len(hi_m)
    ev_lo, ev_hi = int(lo_m["_e"].sum()), int(hi_m["_e"].sum())
    lr_p = np.nan
    if n_lo >= 3 and n_hi >= 3:
        try:
            lr_p = float(logrank_test(lo_m["_t"], hi_m["_t"], lo_m["_e"], hi_m["_e"]).p_value)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if n_lo < 8 or n_hi < 8 or (ev_lo + ev_hi) < 3 or d["hi"].nunique() < 2:
        return (np.nan,) * 5 + (n_lo, n_hi, ev_lo, ev_hi, lr_p)
    sd = stage_dummies(d["stage_num"], prefix="stage")
    fit_df = pd.concat([d[["_t", "_e", "hi", "age", "ecog_ge1"]].reset_index(drop=True),
                        sd.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    for pen in (0.0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0):
        try:
            cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=pen).fit(fit_df, duration_col="_t", event_col="_e")
            hr = float(np.exp(cph.params_["hi"]))
            lo = float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc["hi", "95% lower-bound"]))
            hi = float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc["hi", "95% upper-bound"]))
            p = float(cph.summary.loc["hi", "p"])
            if np.isfinite(hr) and np.isfinite(lo) and np.isfinite(hi) and lo > 0:
                return hr, lo, hi, p, pen > 0, n_lo, n_hi, ev_lo, ev_hi, lr_p
        except Exception:
            continue
    return (np.nan,) * 5 + (n_lo, n_hi, ev_lo, ev_hi, lr_p)


def plot_forest(items, title, out_name, xlabel="Hazard ratio (95% CI, log scale)",
                subtitle="", footer=""):
    items = [it for it in items if it[1] is not None and not np.isnan(it[1])]
    if not items:
        return None
    n = len(items)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.6, 0.52 * n + 2.0))
    ypos = np.arange(n)[::-1]
    for y, (lab, hr, lo, hi, p) in zip(ypos, items):
        lo_p = lo if (lo and lo > 0 and not np.isnan(lo)) else hr
        hi_p = hi if (hi and not np.isnan(hi)) else hr
        col = "#B00020" if (p is not None and p < 0.05) else "#333333"
        ax.plot([lo_p, hi_p], [y, y], "-", color=col, lw=1.8)
        ax.plot(hr, y, "s", color=col, ms=7)
    ax.axvline(1.0, color="#888888", lw=1.0, ls="--")
    ax.set_ylim(-1.4, n - 0.4)
    ax.set_yticks(ypos)
    ax.set_yticklabels([it[0] for it in items], fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    xr = [it[2] for it in items if it[2] and it[2] > 0] + [it[3] for it in items if it[3]]
    lo_lim = max(0.02, min(xr) * 0.7) if xr else 0.1
    hi_lim = min(60, max(xr) * 1.3) if xr else 10
    ax.set_xlim(lo_lim, hi_lim)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
    ax.set_title(title + ("\n" + subtitle if subtitle else ""), fontsize=11)
    hide_spines(ax)
    xtext = hi_lim * 1.02
    for y, (lab, hr, lo, hi, p) in zip(ypos, items):
        ax.text(xtext, y, f"{hr:.2f} ({lo:.2f}\u2013{hi:.2f})  p={fmt_p(p) or '<0.001'}",
                va="center", ha="left", fontsize=8, family="monospace")
    if footer:
        fig.text(0.01, 0.005, footer, fontsize=6.8, color="grey", va="bottom")
    fig.subplots_adjust(right=0.62, left=0.32, top=0.86, bottom=0.14)
    paths = []
    for e in ("png", "pdf"):
        p_out = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f"{out_name}.{e}")
        fig.savefig(p_out, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
        paths.append(p_out)
    plt.close(fig)
    return paths[0]



HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "data")
PATIENTS_FILE = os.path.join(DATA, "galaxy_cohort_demographics.csv")
SAMPLES_FILE = os.path.join(DATA, "galaxy_cohort_testResult.csv")

MRD_LO, MRD_HI = 14, 70
EARLY_HI, DELAYED_HI, LATE_HI = 56, 84, 168
LONG_ACT_MIN_DAYS = 90
MIN_ACT_DAYS = 14
ACT_START_MAX_DAYS = 120
MIN_FU_AFTER_TP2 = 180
ACT_ARMS = ["early", "delayed", "late", "no_ACT"]

_EVALUABLE = None
_COHORT3 = None


def _select_tp1(ps, adj_start, has_act):
    c = ps[(ps["days_after_surgery"] >= MRD_LO) & (ps["days_after_surgery"] <= MRD_HI)]
    if has_act and not pd.isna(adj_start):
        c = c[c["days_after_surgery"] <= adj_start]
    if c.empty:
        return None
    return c.loc[c["days_after_surgery"].idxmax()]


def _assign_arm(has_act, adj_start_days):
    if not has_act:
        return "no_ACT"
    if pd.isna(adj_start_days):
        return "excluded"
    if adj_start_days < EARLY_HI:
        return "early"
    if adj_start_days < DELAYED_HI:
        return "delayed"
    if adj_start_days <= LATE_HI:
        return "late"
    return "excluded"


def _build():
    patients = pd.read_csv(PATIENTS_FILE, low_memory=False)
    patients["Bundling.ID"] = patients["Bundling.ID"].astype(str)
    samples = pd.read_csv(SAMPLES_FILE, low_memory=False)
    samples["Bundling.ID"] = samples["Bundling.ID"].astype(str)
    samples = samples[samples["days_after_surgery"] >= MIN_ACT_DAYS].copy()
    samp_by_id = {pid: s for pid, s in samples.groupby("Bundling.ID")}

    mrd = []
    for _, p in patients.iterrows():
        ps = samp_by_id.get(p["Bundling.ID"])
        if ps is None:
            continue
        r = _select_tp1(ps, p["adj_start_days"], bool(p["has_act"]))
        if r is None:
            continue
        mrd.append({"Bundling.ID": p["Bundling.ID"], "mrd_day": r["days_after_surgery"],
                    "mrd_mtm": r["MTM"]})
    mrd = pd.DataFrame(mrd)
    evaluable = patients.merge(mrd, on="Bundling.ID", how="inner")
    evaluable["mrd_pos"] = evaluable["mrd_mtm"] > 0
    evaluable["arm"] = [_assign_arm(h, d) for h, d in
                        zip(evaluable["has_act"], evaluable["adj_start_days"])]

    adj = patients[patients["has_act"] == True].copy()
    adj = adj[adj["adj_start_days"].notna() & adj["adj_end_days"].notna() &
              adj["adj_duration"].notna()]
    adj = adj[adj["adj_duration"] >= MIN_ACT_DAYS]
    adj = adj[~(adj["adj_start_days"] > ACT_START_MAX_DAYS)]
    adj["cohort_def"] = np.where(adj["adj_duration"] >= LONG_ACT_MIN_DAYS, "long", "short")

    records = []
    for _, pat in adj.iterrows():
        pid, adj_start, adj_end = pat["Bundling.ID"], pat["adj_start_days"], pat["adj_end_days"]
        ps = samp_by_id.get(pid)
        if ps is None:
            continue
        tp1 = _select_tp1(ps, adj_start, True)
        if tp1 is None:
            continue
        tp1_day = tp1["days_after_surgery"]

        if pat["cohort_def"] == "long":
            midpoint = adj_start + 90
            cand = ps[(ps["days_after_surgery"] >= midpoint - 45) &
                      (ps["days_after_surgery"] <= midpoint + 45) &
                      (ps["days_after_surgery"] >= adj_start + 30) &
                      (ps["days_after_surgery"] <= adj_end - 30) &
                      (ps["days_after_surgery"] > tp1_day)]
            cand = cand[cand.index != tp1.name]
            if cand.empty:
                continue
            dist = (cand["days_after_surgery"] - midpoint).abs()
            closest = cand[dist == dist.min()]
            tp2 = closest.loc[closest["days_after_surgery"].idxmax()]
            tp2_day = tp2["days_after_surgery"]
            if (tp2_day - adj_start) > 600:
                continue
        else:
            cand = ps[ps["days_after_surgery"] > adj_end]
            cand = cand[cand.index != tp1.name]
            if cand.empty:
                continue
            dist = cand["days_after_surgery"] - adj_end
            closest = cand[dist == dist.min()]
            tp2 = closest.loc[closest["days_after_surgery"].idxmin()]
            tp2_day = tp2["days_after_surgery"]
            tp2_rel = tp2_day - adj_start
            if tp2_rel < 14 or tp2_rel > 180:
                continue

        records.append({"Bundling.ID": pid, "cohort_def": pat["cohort_def"],
                        "adj_duration": pat["adj_duration"], "adj_start_days": adj_start,
                        "adj_end_days": adj_end, "tp1_day": tp1_day, "MTM_tp1": tp1["MTM"],
                        "tp2_day": tp2_day, "MTM_tp2": tp2["MTM"],
                        "tp2_days_after_act_start": tp2_day - adj_start,
                        "p_drelDFS_Any": pat["p_drelDFS_Any"], "p_evtDFS": pat["p_evtDFS"]})

    combined = pd.DataFrame(records)
    combined["fu_from_tp2"] = combined["p_drelDFS_Any"] - combined["tp2_day"]
    had_event = combined["p_evtDFS"].astype(bool)
    insufficient = (combined["fu_from_tp2"] < MIN_FU_AFTER_TP2) & ~had_event
    combined = combined[~insufficient].copy()

    m1 = combined["MTM_tp1"].fillna(0)
    m2 = combined["MTM_tp2"].fillna(0)
    conditions = [(m1 == 0) & (m2 == 0), (m1 == 0) & (m2 > 0), (m1 > 0) & (m2 == 0),
                  (m1 > 0) & (m2 > 0) & (m2 < m1), (m1 > 0) & (m2 > m1)]
    choices = ["sustained_negative", "newly_detectable", "clearance",
               "decrease_detectable", "rising"]
    combined["ctdna_dynamics"] = np.select(conditions, choices, default="unassigned")

    demo_merge = adj.drop(columns=["adj_start_days", "adj_end_days", "adj_duration",
                                   "p_drelDFS_Any", "p_evtDFS"], errors="ignore")
    dyn = combined.merge(demo_merge, on="Bundling.ID", how="left", suffixes=("", "_demo"))
    dyn["age"] = pd.to_numeric(dyn["Age"], errors="coerce")
    dyn["ecog_ge1"] = np.where(pd.to_numeric(dyn["ECOG"], errors="coerce") >= 1, 1.0, 0.0)
    dyn.loc[dyn["ECOG"].isna(), "ecog_ge1"] = np.nan

    return evaluable, dyn


def _ensure():
    global _EVALUABLE, _COHORT3
    if _EVALUABLE is None or _COHORT3 is None:
        _EVALUABLE, _COHORT3 = _build()


def load_evaluable_cohort():
    _ensure()
    return _EVALUABLE.copy()


def load_act_timing_cohort():
    _ensure()
    return _EVALUABLE[_EVALUABLE["arm"].isin(ACT_ARMS)].copy()


def load_dynamics_cohort():
    _ensure()
    return _COHORT3.copy()

"""Generates Supplementary Table 1 and Supplementary Table 2."""
from _common import (OUT_DIR, derive_baseline, build_demographics_table,
                     load_act_timing_cohort, simplify_stage)
import os

# ── Cohort: ACT start-timing cohort, with stage + baseline variables ─────────────
m = load_act_timing_cohort()
m["stage_num"] = m["p_StagePath"].apply(simplify_stage)
m = derive_baseline(m, "mrd_mtm")

ARM = {"no_ACT": "No ACT", "early": "ACT 0\u20138w", "delayed": "ACT 8\u201312w",
       "late": "ACT 12\u201324w"}

    ("All",            pos),
    ("No ACT",         pos[pos["arm"] == "no_ACT"]),
    ("ACT 0\u20138w",  pos[pos["arm"] == "early"]),

    ("ACT 12\u201324w", pos[pos["arm"] == "late"]),
]

supp1[P_PAIR] = build_demographics_table(cols1, groups_pair, include_mrd_row=False)["p"].values

Figure 2A–2B and Supplementary Figures 1–2 — ACT timing among MRD-positive patients

Code

"""Generates Figure 2A, Figure 2B, Supplementary Figure 1, and Supplementary Figure 2."""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from _common import (OUT_DIR, DAYS_PER_MONTH, load_act_timing_cohort, simplify_stage,
                     fit_km, draw_km_curve, draw_risk_table, landmark_frame,
                     landmark_cox_adjusted, adj_rmst_contrasts, rmst_difference,
                     mtm_hi_lo_cox, fmt_p, hide_spines)

LM = 84                                  # 12-week landmark (days)
COVS = ("stage", "age", "ecog", "mtm")
ARM_LBL = {"no_ACT": "No ACT", "early": "ACT 0\u20138w", "delayed": "ACT 8\u201312w"}
ARM_COL = {"no_ACT": "#9E9E9E", "early": "#1B5E20", "delayed": "#008BCE"}
ARMS = ["no_ACT", "early", "delayed"]

# ── Build the MRD-positive cohort with model covariates ─────────────────────────
m = load_act_timing_cohort()
m["stage_num"] = m["p_StagePath"].apply(simplify_stage)
m["age"] = pd.to_numeric(m["Age"], errors="coerce")
m["ecog_ge1"] = np.where(pd.to_numeric(m["ECOG"], errors="coerce") >= 1, 1.0, 0.0)
m.loc[m["ECOG"].isna(), "ecog_ge1"] = np.nan
pos = m[m["mrd_pos"]].copy()
print(f"TP#1 MRD-positive cohort: N = {len(pos)}")


def km_panel(endpoint, panel, title):
    d = landmark_frame(pos, LM, endpoint)
    hr_vs_noACT = landmark_cox_adjusted(d, ARMS, "no_ACT", COVS)       # early & delayed vs No ACT
    hr_e_vs_d   = landmark_cox_adjusted(d, ["early", "delayed"], "early", COVS)  # delayed vs early

    xmax = int(np.ceil(d["_t"].max() / 6) * 6)
    xticks = list(range(0, xmax + 1, 6))
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8.2, 7.2))
    gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 1, height_ratios=[4.0, 1.15], hspace=0.07)
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0]); rax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1], sharex=ax)

    strata = []
    for a in ARMS:
        sub = d[d["arm"] == a]
        if len(sub) == 0:
            continue
        kmf = fit_km(sub["_t"].values, sub["_e"].values,
                     label=f"{ARM_LBL[a]} (n={len(sub)}, ev={int(sub['_e'].sum())})")
        draw_km_curve(ax, kmf, ARM_COL[a], label=f"{ARM_LBL[a]} (n={len(sub)}, ev={int(sub['_e'].sum())})")
        strata.append((ARM_LBL[a], ARM_COL[a], sub["_t"].values))
    ax.set_xlim(-1, xmax + 1)
    ax.set_ylabel(f"{endpoint} probability")
    ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.03)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    hide_spines(ax)
    ax.tick_params(labelbottom=False)
    ax.legend(loc="lower left", fontsize=8.5, frameon=False)

    # delayed vs early = inverse of the (delayed-vs-early) HR from the two-arm fit
    de = hr_e_vs_d.get("delayed")
    e_vs_d = (1 / de[0], 1 / de[2], 1 / de[1], de[3]) if de else None
    e = hr_vs_noACT.get("early"); dd = hr_vs_noACT.get("delayed")
    lines = []
    if e:
        lines.append(f"ACT 0\u20138w vs No ACT : HR {e[0]:.2f} ({e[1]:.2f}\u2013{e[2]:.2f}), p={fmt_p(e[3]) or '<0.001'}")
    if dd:
        lines.append(f"ACT 8\u201312w vs No ACT: HR {dd[0]:.2f} ({dd[1]:.2f}\u2013{dd[2]:.2f}), p={fmt_p(dd[3]) or '<0.001'}")
    if e_vs_d:
        lines.append(f"ACT 0\u20138w vs 8\u201312w : HR {e_vs_d[0]:.2f} ({e_vs_d[1]:.2f}\u2013{e_vs_d[2]:.2f}), p={fmt_p(e_vs_d[3]) or '<0.001'}")
    ax.text(0.97, 0.52, "Adjusted HR (stage+age+ECOG+log(1+MTM))\n" + "\n".join(lines),
            transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.2, va="top", ha="right", family="monospace",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", fc="white", ec="grey", alpha=0.9))

    draw_risk_table(rax, strata, xticks, (-1, xmax + 1),
                    xlabel="Months from 12-week landmark")
    for ext in ("png", "pdf"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f"figure_2{panel}_{endpoint}_landmark_km.{ext}"),
                    dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)

    rows = []
    for ref, cmp, tup in [("No ACT", "ACT 0\u20138w", e), ("No ACT", "ACT 8\u201312w", dd),
                          ("ACT 8\u201312w", "ACT 0\u20138w", e_vs_d)]:
        if tup:
            rows.append({"panel": f"2{panel}", "endpoint": endpoint, "reference": ref,
                         "comparison": cmp, "HR": round(tup[0], 3), "CI_low": round(tup[1], 3),
                         "CI_high": round(tup[2], 3), "p": round(tup[3], 5)})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ── Figure 2A (DFS) and Figure 2B (OS) ───────────────────────────────────────────
tab_dfs = km_panel("DFS", "A", "Figure 2A. DFS by ACT timing (MRD-positive)")
tab_os  = km_panel("OS",  "B", "Figure 2B. OS by ACT timing (MRD-positive)")
hr_tab = pd.concat([tab_dfs, tab_os], ignore_index=True)
hr_tab.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "figure_2AB_landmark_adjusted_HRs.csv"), index=False)
print("\nFigure 2A / 2B — adjusted landmark hazard ratios")
print(hr_tab.to_string(index=False))


# ── Supplementary Figure 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
d_dfs = landmark_frame(pos, LM, "DFS")
present = [a for a in ["no_ACT", "early", "delayed", "late"]
           if int((d_dfs["arm"] == a).sum()) >= 5]
grid_max = min(float(d_dfs[d_dfs["arm"] == a]["_t"].max()) for a in present)
horizons = list(range(6, int(grid_max // 6) * 6 + 1, 6))
ref_t = d_dfs[d_dfs["arm"] == "no_ACT"]["_t"].values
ref_e = d_dfs[d_dfs["arm"] == "no_ACT"]["_e"].values

CURVES = [("early", "ACT 0\u20138w", "#1B5E20"), ("delayed", "ACT 8\u201312w", "#008BCE")]
gain = {a: {"adj": [], "un": []} for a, _, _ in CURVES}   # RMST gain vs No ACT
# direct adjusted contrasts (reported at 24 & 36 mo): {contrast: {H: (diff,lo,hi,p)}}
direct = {"Early vs No ACT": {}, "Delayed vs No ACT": {}, "Early vs Delayed": {}}

for h in horizons:
    vs_no = adj_rmst_contrasts(d_dfs, present, "no_ACT", COVS, h)      # early & delayed vs No ACT
    for a, _, _ in CURVES:
        sub = d_dfs[d_dfs["arm"] == a]
        gain[a]["adj"].append(vs_no[a][0])
        gain[a]["un"].append(rmst_difference(ref_t, ref_e, sub["_t"].values, sub["_e"].values, h)[0])
    direct["Early vs No ACT"][h] = vs_no["early"]
    direct["Delayed vs No ACT"][h] = vs_no["delayed"]
    # early vs delayed: separate two-arm model (reference = delayed -> "early" = early - delayed)
    direct["Early vs Delayed"][h] = adj_rmst_contrasts(d_dfs, ["delayed", "early"], "delayed", COVS, h)["early"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.6))
for a, lbl, color in CURVES:
    ax.plot(horizons, gain[a]["adj"], "-o", color=color, lw=2.6, ms=5, label=f"{lbl} (adjusted)")
    ax.plot(horizons, gain[a]["un"], ":", color=color, lw=1.6, alpha=0.7, label=f"{lbl} (unadjusted)")
ax.axhline(0, color="#555555", lw=1.0, ls="--")
ax.set_xlabel("Months from 12-week landmark")
ax.set_ylabel("RMST gain vs No ACT (DFS, months)")
ax.set_title("Supplementary Figure 1. RMST Difference in Disease-Free Survival by ACT Initiation Timing",
             fontsize=11.5, fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xticks(horizons); ax.grid(axis="y", color="#DDDDDD", lw=0.8)
hide_spines(ax)
ax.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=9, frameon=False)

# side annotation: direct adjusted RMST contrasts at 24 and 36 months only
blocks = [("Early vs Delayed ACT: adj. RMST (direct):", "Early vs Delayed"),
          ("Early vs No ACT: adj. RMST (direct):", "Early vs No ACT"),
          ("Delayed vs No ACT: adj. RMST (direct):", "Delayed vs No ACT")]
ann = []
for head, key in blocks:
    ann.append(head)
    for H in (24, 36):
        diff, lo, hi, p = direct[key][H]
        pp = "P<0.001" if (p is not None and p < 0.001) else f"p = {p:.3f}"
        ann.append(f"  {H} mo: {diff:+.2f} ({lo:.2f} to {hi:.2f}), {pp}")
    ann.append("")
ax.text(1.02, 0.5, "\n".join(ann).rstrip(), transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.4,
        va="center", ha="left", family="monospace")
fig.subplots_adjust(right=0.63)
for ext in ("png", "pdf"):
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f"supplementary_figure_1_rmst_gain_DFS.{ext}"),
                dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
plt.close(fig)

# CSV: the direct adjusted RMST contrasts at 24 and 36 months (manuscript values)
rows24_36 = []
for head, key in blocks:
    for H in (24, 36):
        diff, lo, hi, p = direct[key][H]
        rows24_36.append({"contrast": key, "horizon_mo": H, "RMST_diff_mo": round(diff, 2),
                          "CI_low": round(lo, 2), "CI_high": round(hi, 2), "p": round(p, 4)})
rmst_df = pd.DataFrame(rows24_36)
rmst_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "supplementary_figure_1_rmst_contrasts.csv"), index=False)
print("\nSupplementary Figure 1 — direct adjusted RMST contrasts (24 & 36 months)")
print(rmst_df.to_string(index=False))


# ── Supplementary Figure 2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mtm_median = pos["mrd_mtm"].median()
pos["mtm_grp"] = np.where(pos["mrd_mtm"] >= mtm_median, "high", "low")
print(f"\nMedian TP#1 ctDNA burden across the MRD-positive cohort = {mtm_median:.3f} MTM/mL")

STRATA = [("no_ACT", "low"), ("no_ACT", "high"),

fig.suptitle(f"Supplementary Figure 2. DFS (A) and OS (B) by ACT initiation timing and TP#1 ctDNA burden "
             f"(median split at {mtm_median:.3f} MTM/mL; within-arm high-vs-low HR adjusted for stage + age + ECOG\u22651)",
             fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")

for col, (endpoint, panel) in enumerate([("DFS", "A"), ("OS", "B")]):

        mtm_rows.append({"arm": ROW_LBL[arm], "endpoint": endpoint, "n_low": n_lo, "n_high": n_hi,

    for i, (c, txt) in enumerate(ann_lines):

    ax.set_ylabel(f"{endpoint} probability", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_title(f"{panel}. MRD-positive patients (all stages) \u2013 {endpoint} by ACT timing and TP#1 ctDNA burden",
                 fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold")
    hide_spines(ax); ax.tick_params(labelbottom=False)
    ax.legend(loc="lower left", fontsize=7.6, frameon=False, ncol=1)
    draw_risk_table(rax, risk_strata, xticks, (-1, xmax + 1),
                    xlabel="Months from 12-week landmark", fontsize=7.5)

fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.91)
for ext in ("png", "pdf"):

"""Generates Figure 2C, Figure 2D, and Figure 2E."""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from lifelines import CoxPHFitter

from _common import OUT_DIR, DAYS_PER_MONTH, load_act_timing_cohort, simplify_stage, \
    plot_forest, fmt_p

MIN_EVENTS = 5
STAGE_ORDER = ["I\u2013II", "III", "IV"]        # display order; reference = first present

# ── Load cohort + derive encoded predictors (late starters, ACT 8-24w) ──────────
m = load_act_timing_cohort()
m["stage_num"] = m["p_StagePath"].apply(simplify_stage)
m["age"] = pd.to_numeric(m["Age"], errors="coerce")
m["ecog_ge1"] = np.where(pd.to_numeric(m["ECOG"], errors="coerce") >= 1, 1.0, 0.0)
m.loc[m["ECOG"].isna(), "ecog_ge1"] = np.nan
m["male"] = np.where(m["Sex"] == "Male", 1.0, np.where(m["Sex"] == "Female", 0.0, np.nan))
m["pT4"] = m["pT"].apply(lambda x: 1.0 if str(x).startswith("pT4")
                         else (0.0 if str(x).startswith(("pT1", "pT2", "pT3")) else np.nan))
m["pN_pos"] = m["pN"].apply(lambda x: 0.0 if str(x).startswith("pN0")
                            else (1.0 if str(x).startswith(("pN1", "pN2")) else np.nan))
m["right_sided"] = np.where(m["LocationGrpA"] == "Right-sided colon", 1.0,
                            np.where(m["LocationGrpA"] == "Left-sided colon", 0.0, np.nan))
m["rectum"] = np.where(m["LocationGrpB"] == "Rectum", 1.0,
                       np.where(m["LocationGrpB"] == "Colon", 0.0, np.nan))

m["msi_h"]    = m["msi_call"].map({"MSS": 0.0, "MSI-High": 1.0})
m["ras_pos"]  = m["ras_call"].map({"WT": 0.0, "MUT": 1.0})
m["braf_pos"] = m["braf_call"].map({"WT": 0.0, "MUT": 1.0})
m["lvi_present"] = m["p_LVI"].apply(lambda x: np.nan if pd.isna(x)
                                    else (1.0 if ("Ly1" in str(x) or "V1" in str(x)) else 0.0))
m["pni_present"] = m["p_PNI"].apply(lambda x: 1.0 if str(x).startswith("Pn1")
                                    else (0.0 if str(x).startswith("Pn0") else np.nan))
m["mrd_pos_f"] = m["mrd_pos"].astype(float)
m["age10"] = m["age"] / 10.0
m["log1p_mtm"] = np.log1p(pd.to_numeric(m["mrd_mtm"], errors="coerce"))

coh = m[m["arm"].isin(["delayed", "late"])].copy()
coh["_t"] = pd.to_numeric(coh["dfs_days"], errors="coerce") / DAYS_PER_MONTH
coh["_e"] = pd.to_numeric(coh["dfs_evt"], errors="coerce")
coh = coh[coh["_t"].notna() & coh["_e"].notna() & (coh["_t"] > 0)].copy()
print(f"Late-starter cohort (ACT 8\u201324w): n={len(coh)}, DFS events={int(coh['_e'].sum())}")


def stage_group(d):
    g = pd.to_numeric(d["stage_num"], errors="coerce")
    return pd.Series(np.select([g.isin([1, 2]), g.eq(3), g.eq(4)], STAGE_ORDER, default=None),
                     index=d.index).where(lambda s: s.notna())


def build_stage_cols(d):
    grp = stage_group(d)
    if grp.dropna().nunique() < 2:
        return []
    ref = [s for s in STAGE_ORDER if (grp == s).any()][0]
    dd = pd.get_dummies(grp, prefix="stage").astype(float)
    dd = dd.drop(columns=[f"stage_{ref}"]) if f"stage_{ref}" in dd.columns else dd
    order = [f"stage_{s}" for s in STAGE_ORDER if f"stage_{s}" in dd.columns]
    dd = dd[order]
    for c in dd.columns:
        d[c] = dd[c]
    return list(dd.columns)


def stage_ref(d):
    present = [s for s in STAGE_ORDER if (stage_group(d) == s).any()]
    return present[0] if len(present) >= 2 else "reference"


def cox_fit(d, cols, penalizers=(0.0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0)):
    use = d.dropna(subset=["_t", "_e"] + cols).copy()
    n, ev = len(use), int(use["_e"].sum())
    meta = {"n": n, "events": ev, "cindex": np.nan, "penalized": None}
    if n == 0 or ev < MIN_EVENTS or use[cols].nunique().min() < 2:
        return [], meta
    fit_df = use[["_t", "_e"] + cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    last = None
    for pen in penalizers:
        try:
            cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=pen).fit(fit_df, duration_col="_t", event_col="_e")
            rows = [{"covariate": c, "HR": float(np.exp(cph.params_[c])),
                     "CI_low": float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[c, "95% lower-bound"])),
                     "CI_high": float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[c, "95% upper-bound"])),
                     "p": float(cph.summary.loc[c, "p"])} for c in cols if c in cph.params_.index]
            meta.update({"cindex": float(cph.concordance_index_), "penalized": bool(pen > 0)})
            degenerate = any((abs(np.log(r["HR"])) > 5) or (not np.isfinite(r["CI_low"]))
                             or (not np.isfinite(r["CI_high"])) or r["CI_low"] <= 0 for r in rows)
            last = (rows, dict(meta))
            if not degenerate:
                return rows, meta
        except Exception:
            continue
    return last if last is not None else ([], meta)


UNI_VARS = [("MRD-window ctDNA positive", "mrd_pos_f"), ("Age (per 10 y)", "age10"),
            ("ECOG \u22651", "ecog_ge1"), ("Male sex", "male"), ("pT4 (vs T1\u2013T3)", "pT4"),
            ("Node positive (N1/N2)", "pN_pos"), ("Right-sided (vs left)", "right_sided"),
            ("Rectum (vs colon)", "rectum"), ("MSI-H (vs MSS/pMMR)", "msi_h"),
            ("RAS mutant", "ras_pos"), ("BRAF mutant", "braf_pos"),
            ("LVI present", "lvi_present"), ("PNI present", "pni_present"),
            ("log(1+MTM) [all]", "log1p_mtm")]


def label_of(col, ref_roman):
    if col.startswith("stage_"):
        return f"Stage {col.split('_', 1)[1]} (vs {ref_roman})"
    for lab, c in UNI_VARS:
        if c == col:
            return lab
    return col


# ── Figure 2C ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
stage_cols = build_stage_cols(coh)
ref = stage_ref(coh)
uni_rows, uni_forest = [], []
srows, smeta = cox_fit(coh, stage_cols)
for r in srows:
    uni_rows.append({"variable": label_of(r["covariate"], ref), "HR": round(r["HR"], 3),
                     "CI_low": round(r["CI_low"], 3), "CI_high": round(r["CI_high"], 3),
                     "p": round(r["p"], 4), "n": smeta["n"], "events": smeta["events"]})
    uni_forest.append((label_of(r["covariate"], ref), r["HR"], r["CI_low"], r["CI_high"], r["p"]))
for lab, col in UNI_VARS:
    rows, meta = cox_fit(coh, [col])
    if not rows:
        continue
    r = rows[0]
    uni_rows.append({"variable": lab, "HR": round(r["HR"], 3), "CI_low": round(r["CI_low"], 3),
                     "CI_high": round(r["CI_high"], 3), "p": round(r["p"], 4),
                     "n": meta["n"], "events": meta["events"]})
    uni_forest.append((lab, r["HR"], r["CI_low"], r["CI_high"], r["p"]))

uni_df = pd.DataFrame(uni_rows)
uni_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "figure_2C_univariable_DFS.csv"), index=False)
plot_forest(uni_forest, "Figure 2C. Univariable predictors of DFS (ACT 8\u201324w)",
            "figure_2C_univariable_forest", xlabel="Hazard ratio for DFS event (95% CI, log scale)",
            subtitle=f"n={len(coh)}, events={int(coh['_e'].sum())}; each row = separate model")
print("\nFIGURE 2C — univariable predictors of DFS")
print(uni_df.to_string(index=False))


# ── Figure 2D ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
core_cols = ["mrd_pos_f"] + stage_cols + ["age10", "ecog_ge1", "right_sided"]
crows, cmeta = cox_fit(coh, core_cols)
core_rows, core_forest = [], []
for r in crows:
    core_rows.append({"variable": label_of(r["covariate"], ref), "HR": round(r["HR"], 3),
                      "CI_low": round(r["CI_low"], 3), "CI_high": round(r["CI_high"], 3),
                      "p": round(r["p"], 4), "n_model": cmeta["n"], "events_model": cmeta["events"],
                      "C_index": round(cmeta["cindex"], 3)})
    core_forest.append((label_of(r["covariate"], ref), r["HR"], r["CI_low"], r["CI_high"], r["p"]))
core_df = pd.DataFrame(core_rows)
core_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "figure_2D_multivariable_CORE_DFS.csv"), index=False)
plot_forest(core_forest, "Figure 2D. Multivariable (CORE) predictors of DFS (ACT 8\u201324w)",
            "figure_2D_multivariable_forest", xlabel="Hazard ratio for DFS event (95% CI, log scale)",
            subtitle=f"n={cmeta['n']}, events={cmeta['events']}, C-index={cmeta['cindex']:.3f}; mutually adjusted")
print(f"\nFIGURE 2D — CORE multivariable model (n={cmeta['n']}, events={cmeta['events']}, "
      f"C-index={cmeta['cindex']:.3f})")
print(core_df.to_string(index=False))


# ── Figure 2E ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pos = coh[coh["mrd_pos"] & (coh["stage_num"].isin([1, 2, 3]))].copy()
pos["stage_III"] = (pd.to_numeric(pos["stage_num"], errors="coerce") == 3).astype(float)
e2_cols = ["log1p_mtm", "stage_III", "age10", "ecog_ge1", "right_sided"]
erows, emeta = cox_fit(pos, e2_cols, penalizers=(0.0,))
LBL2E = {"log1p_mtm": "log(1+MTM) per unit", "stage_III": "Stage III (vs I\u2013II)",
         "age10": "Age (per 10 y)", "ecog_ge1": "ECOG \u22651", "right_sided": "Right-sided (vs left)"}
e2_rows, e2_forest = [], []
for r in erows:
    e2_rows.append({"variable": LBL2E.get(r["covariate"], r["covariate"]), "HR": round(r["HR"], 3),
                    "CI_low": round(r["CI_low"], 3), "CI_high": round(r["CI_high"], 3),
                    "p": round(r["p"], 4), "n_model": emeta["n"], "events_model": emeta["events"],
                    "C_index": round(emeta["cindex"], 3)})
    e2_forest.append((LBL2E.get(r["covariate"], r["covariate"]), r["HR"], r["CI_low"], r["CI_high"], r["p"]))
e2_df = pd.DataFrame(e2_rows)
e2_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "figure_2E_MRDpos_ctdna_burden_DFS.csv"), index=False)
plot_forest(e2_forest, "Figure 2E. Multivariate analysis with ctDNA levels log(1+MTM/mL) (ACT 8\u201324w) (Stage I\u2013III)",
            "figure_2E_ctdna_burden_forest", xlabel="Hazard ratio for DFS event (95% CI, log scale)",
            subtitle=f"MRD+ (Stage I\u2013III); n={emeta['n']}, events={emeta['events']}, C-index={emeta['cindex']:.3f}")
print(f"\nFIGURE 2E — ctDNA burden (MRD+, Stage I\u2013III; n={emeta['n']}, events={emeta['events']})")
print(e2_df.to_string(index=False))

Post-operative complication confounding assessment (Cohort 1)

Code

"""Generates the post-operative complication confounding assessment (Cohort 1)."""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from lifelines import CoxPHFitter
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

from _common import OUT_DIR, DAYS_PER_MONTH, load_act_timing_cohort, \
    simplify_stage, stage_dummies, fmt_p

LM = 84
MODEL_COVS = ["stage_num", "age", "ecog_ge1", "log_mtm"]

# ── Assemble the MRD-positive early+delayed landmark frame with complications ────
m = load_act_timing_cohort()
m["stage_num"] = m["p_StagePath"].apply(simplify_stage)
pos = m[m["mrd_pos"]].copy()

ed = pos[pos["arm"].isin(["early", "delayed"])].copy()   # cd2 = Clavien-Dindo >=2 complication flag
ed["age"] = pd.to_numeric(ed["Age"], errors="coerce")
ed["ecog_ge1"] = np.where(pd.to_numeric(ed["ECOG"], errors="coerce") >= 1, 1.0, 0.0)
ed.loc[ed["ECOG"].isna(), "ecog_ge1"] = np.nan
ed["log_mtm"] = np.log1p(pd.to_numeric(ed["mrd_mtm"], errors="coerce"))
ed["cd2"] = pd.to_numeric(ed["cd2"], errors="coerce")

ed = ed[ed["dfs_days"].notna() & (ed["dfs_days"] >= LM)].copy()
ed["_t"] = (pd.to_numeric(ed["dfs_days"], errors="coerce") - LM) / DAYS_PER_MONTH
ed["_e"] = pd.to_numeric(ed["dfs_evt"], errors="coerce").astype(int)
same = (ed["_t"] == 0) & (ed["_e"] == 1)
ed.loc[same, "_t"] = 1.0 / DAYS_PER_MONTH

base_full = ed.dropna(subset=["_t", "_e"] + MODEL_COVS).copy()
cc = base_full.dropna(subset=["cd2"]).copy()   # complication-known subset


def fit_delayed_hr(dd, extra_cols=()):
    parts = [stage_dummies(dd["stage_num"], "stage"), dd[["age"]].astype(float),
             dd[["ecog_ge1"]].astype(float), dd[["log_mtm"]].astype(float)]
    for c in extra_cols:
        parts.append(dd[[c]].astype(float))
    adj = pd.concat(parts, axis=1)
    arm = pd.get_dummies(dd["arm"], prefix="g").astype(float)
    if "g_early" in arm.columns:
        arm = arm.drop(columns=["g_early"])
    fit_df = pd.concat([dd[["_t", "_e"]].reset_index(drop=True), arm.reset_index(drop=True),
                        adj.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    for pen in (0.0, 0.1, 0.5):
        try:
            cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=pen).fit(fit_df, "_t", "_e")
            col = "g_delayed"
            return (float(np.exp(cph.params_[col])),
                    float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% lower-bound"])),
                    float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% upper-bound"])),
                    float(cph.summary.loc[col, "p"]), pen > 0, len(dd), int(dd["_e"].sum()))
        except Exception:
            continue
    return (np.nan,) * 7


def fit_cov_hr(dd, col):
    parts = [stage_dummies(dd["stage_num"], "stage"), dd[["age"]].astype(float),
             dd[["ecog_ge1"]].astype(float), dd[["log_mtm"]].astype(float), dd[[col]].astype(float)]
    arm = pd.get_dummies(dd["arm"], prefix="g").astype(float)
    if "g_early" in arm.columns:
        arm = arm.drop(columns=["g_early"])
    parts.append(arm)
    fit_df = pd.concat([dd[["_t", "_e"]].reset_index(drop=True),
                        pd.concat(parts, axis=1).reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    for pen in (0.0, 0.1, 0.5):
        try:
            cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=pen).fit(fit_df, "_t", "_e")
            return (float(np.exp(cph.params_[col])),
                    float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% lower-bound"])),
                    float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% upper-bound"])),
                    float(cph.summary.loc[col, "p"]), pen > 0)
        except Exception:
            continue
    return (np.nan,) * 5


print("=" * 78)
print("Surgical-complication (Clavien-Dindo >=2) confounding analysis")
print("=" * 78)
print(f"Early+delayed after 12-wk landmark & complete model covariates : n={len(base_full)} "
      f"(early={int((base_full['arm']=='early').sum())}, delayed={int((base_full['arm']=='delayed').sum())})")
print(f"Complication status known (CD>=2 non-missing)                  : n={len(cc)} "
      f"(missing = {len(base_full) - len(cc)})")

# ── (a) complication vs EXPOSURE (ACT timing) ────────────────────────────────────
tab = pd.crosstab(cc["arm"], cc["cd2"])
print("\n(a) Association of complication with ACT timing (exposure):")
rate = {}
for a in ["early", "delayed"]:
    n1 = int(tab.loc[a].get(1.0, 0)); n0 = int(tab.loc[a].get(0.0, 0))
    rate[a] = 100 * n1 / (n0 + n1)
    print(f"    {a:<8}: CD>=2 {n1}/{n0 + n1} ({rate[a]:.1f}%)")
orr, pf = fisher_exact([[int(tab.loc["early", 1.0]), int(tab.loc["early", 0.0])],
                        [int(tab.loc["delayed", 1.0]), int(tab.loc["delayed", 0.0])]])
print(f"    Fisher exact (delayed vs early CD>=2): OR={orr:.3f}, p={pf:.3f}")

# ── (b) complication vs OUTCOME (DFS) ────────────────────────────────────────────
cd_hr = fit_cov_hr(cc, "cd2")
print("\n(b) Association of complication with DFS (adjusted for arm+stage+age+ECOG+log(1+MTM)):")
print(f"    CD>=2 vs none : HR={cd_hr[0]:.3f} ({cd_hr[1]:.3f}-{cd_hr[2]:.3f}) p={cd_hr[3]:.3f}")

# ── (c) change-in-estimate for the timing HR ─────────────────────────────────────
hr_primary = fit_delayed_hr(base_full)
hr_base_cc = fit_delayed_hr(cc)
hr_adj_cc  = fit_delayed_hr(cc, extra_cols=["cd2"])
pct = 100 * (hr_adj_cc[0] - hr_base_cc[0]) / hr_base_cc[0]


def inv(tup):
    return 1 / tup[0], 1 / tup[2], 1 / tup[1], tup[3]


print("\n(c) Delayed (8-12w) vs Early (0-8w) DFS HR — change-in-estimate:")
print(f"    Primary model (full n={hr_primary[5]}, ev={hr_primary[6]})          : "
      f"HR={hr_primary[0]:.3f} ({hr_primary[1]:.3f}-{hr_primary[2]:.3f}) p={hr_primary[3]:.4f}")
print(f"    Base model, complication-known subset (n={hr_base_cc[5]}, ev={hr_base_cc[6]}) : "
      f"HR={hr_base_cc[0]:.3f} ({hr_base_cc[1]:.3f}-{hr_base_cc[2]:.3f}) p={hr_base_cc[3]:.4f}")
print(f"    + adjusted for CD>=2 complication (same subset)          : "
      f"HR={hr_adj_cc[0]:.3f} ({hr_adj_cc[1]:.3f}-{hr_adj_cc[2]:.3f}) p={hr_adj_cc[3]:.4f}")
print(f"    Change in timing HR from adding complication             : {pct:+.1f}%")
e = inv(hr_base_cc)
print(f"\n    Manuscript direction — Early (0-8w) vs Delayed (8-12w), adjusted, N={hr_base_cc[5]}: "
      f"HR={e[0]:.2f} ({e[1]:.2f}-{e[2]:.2f}) p={fmt_p(e[3]) or '<0.001'}")

res = pd.DataFrame([
    {"step": "(a) complication ~ timing", "metric": "CD>=2 rate early (%)", "estimate": round(rate["early"], 1)},
    {"step": "(a) complication ~ timing", "metric": "CD>=2 rate delayed (%)", "estimate": round(rate["delayed"], 1)},
    {"step": "(a) complication ~ timing", "metric": "CD>=2 delayed vs early OR", "estimate": round(orr, 3), "p": round(pf, 4)},
    {"step": "(b) complication ~ DFS", "metric": "HR CD>=2 (adj)", "estimate": round(cd_hr[0], 3),
     "ci_low": round(cd_hr[1], 3), "ci_high": round(cd_hr[2], 3), "p": round(cd_hr[3], 4)},
    {"step": "(c) timing HR base (cc subset)", "metric": "HR delayed vs early", "estimate": round(hr_base_cc[0], 3),
     "ci_low": round(hr_base_cc[1], 3), "ci_high": round(hr_base_cc[2], 3), "p": round(hr_base_cc[3], 4)},
    {"step": "(c) timing HR + complication", "metric": "HR delayed vs early (adj CD>=2)", "estimate": round(hr_adj_cc[0], 3),
     "ci_low": round(hr_adj_cc[1], 3), "ci_high": round(hr_adj_cc[2], 3), "p": round(hr_adj_cc[3], 4)},
    {"step": "(c) change-in-estimate", "metric": "percent change in timing HR", "estimate": round(pct, 1)},
    {"step": "(summary) manuscript direction", "metric": "Early vs Delayed adj HR", "estimate": round(e[0], 3),
     "ci_low": round(e[1], 3), "ci_high": round(e[2], 3), "p": round(e[3], 4)},
])
out = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "complication_confounding_summary.csv")
res.to_csv(out, index=False)
print(f"\nSaved -> {out}")

"""Generates Supplementary Table 4."""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from _common import OUT_DIR, load_dynamics_cohort, derive_baseline, build_demographics_table

# ── Cohort: ctDNA-dynamics (1,010); MRD status from TP#1 burden ─────────────────
d = load_dynamics_cohort()
d["mrd_pos"] = pd.to_numeric(d["MTM_tp1"], errors="coerce") > 0
m = derive_baseline(d, "MTM_tp1")

cols = [
    ("All",       m),
    ("Long ACT",  m[m["cohort_def"] == "long"]),
    ("Short ACT", m[m["cohort_def"] == "short"]),
]
groups = [m[m["cohort_def"] == "long"], m[m["cohort_def"] == "short"]]
supp4 = build_demographics_table(cols, groups, include_mrd_row=True)

out = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "supplementary_table_4_cohort3_1010_longVsShort.csv")
supp4.to_csv(out, index=False)

pd.set_option("display.max_rows", None, "display.width", 220)
print("=" * 110)
print("SUPPLEMENTARY TABLE 4 — ctDNA-dynamics / ACT-duration cohort (N = 1,010): Long vs Short ACT")
print("=" * 110)
print(supp4.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nSaved -> {out}")

Supplementary Table 5 and Figure 4 — serial ctDNA dynamics and ACT duration (Cohort 3)

Code

"""Generates Supplementary Table 5 and Figure 4 (panels A-F)."""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from lifelines import CoxPHFitter

from _common import (OUT_DIR, DAYS_PER_MONTH, load_dynamics_cohort, stage_dummies,
                     fit_km, draw_km_curve, draw_risk_table, hide_spines, fmt_p)

MIN_N = 5
GROUP_ORDER = ["sustained_negative", "clearance", "decrease_detectable", "rising", "newly_detectable"]
LABELS = {"sustained_negative": "Sustained negative", "clearance": "Clearance",
          "decrease_detectable": "Decrease but detectable", "rising": "Rising",
          "newly_detectable": "Newly detectable"}
COLORS = {"sustained_negative": "#1B5E20", "clearance": "#8BC400",
          "decrease_detectable": "#008BCE", "rising": "#004677", "newly_detectable": "#E87722"}

df = load_dynamics_cohort()


# ── Landmark preparation (reset the clock at the TP#2/#3 assessment) ─────────────
def landmark_prep(d, dfs_col="p_drelDFS_Any", evt_col="p_evtDFS", lm_col="tp2_day"):
    d = d.dropna(subset=[dfs_col, evt_col, lm_col]).copy()
    d["_evt"] = d[evt_col].astype(int)
    d["_lm_days"] = d[dfs_col] - d[lm_col]
    d = d[d["_lm_days"] >= 0].copy()
    same = (d["_lm_days"] == 0) & (d["_evt"] == 1)
    d.loc[same, "_lm_days"] = 1
    d["_lm_months"] = d["_lm_days"] / DAYS_PER_MONTH
    return d


def cox_binary(ref_t, ref_e, cmp_t, cmp_e, ref_stage, cmp_stage):
    cdf = pd.DataFrame({"T": np.concatenate([ref_t, cmp_t]),
                        "E": np.concatenate([ref_e, cmp_e]),
                        "grp": np.array([0] * len(ref_t) + [1] * len(cmp_t), dtype=float),
                        "stage": np.concatenate([ref_stage, cmp_stage])})
    cdf = cdf.dropna(subset=["stage"])
    st = stage_dummies(cdf["stage"])
    cdf = cdf.drop(columns=["stage"])
    if st.shape[1] >= 1:
        cdf = pd.concat([cdf, st], axis=1)
    for pen in (0.0, 0.1):
        try:
            cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=pen).fit(cdf, "T", "E")
            return (float(np.exp(cph.params_["grp"])),
                    float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc["grp", "95% lower-bound"])),
                    float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc["grp", "95% upper-bound"])),
                    float(cph.summary.loc["grp", "p"]))
        except Exception:
            continue
    return np.nan, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan


def cox_multivariate(lm_df, ref_key="sustained_negative"):
    d = lm_df[["_lm_months", "_evt", "ctdna_dynamics", "stage_num"]].dropna(subset=["_lm_months", "_evt"]).copy()
    dummies = pd.get_dummies(d["ctdna_dynamics"], prefix="grp").astype(float)
    if f"grp_{ref_key}" in dummies.columns:
        dummies = dummies.drop(columns=[f"grp_{ref_key}"])
    cox_df = pd.concat([d[["_lm_months", "_evt", "stage_num"]], dummies], axis=1).dropna(subset=["stage_num"])
    st = stage_dummies(cox_df["stage_num"])
    fit_df = pd.concat([cox_df.drop(columns=["stage_num"]), st], axis=1)
    for pen in (0.0, 0.1):
        try:
            cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=pen).fit(fit_df, "_lm_months", "_evt")
            res = {}
            for gk in GROUP_ORDER:
                col = f"grp_{gk}"
                if col in cph.params_.index:
                    res[gk] = (float(np.exp(cph.params_[col])),
                               float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% lower-bound"])),
                               float(np.exp(cph.confidence_intervals_.loc[col, "95% upper-bound"])),
                               float(cph.summary.loc[col, "p"]))
            return res
        except Exception:
            continue
    return {}


# ── Supplementary Table 5 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
t5 = []
for gk in GROUP_ORDER:
    sub = df[df["ctdna_dynamics"] == gk]
    t5.append({"Dynamic pattern": LABELS[gk], "All (N=1,010)": len(sub),
               "Long ACT": int((sub["cohort_def"] == "long").sum()),
               "Short ACT": int((sub["cohort_def"] == "short").sum())})
t5.append({"Dynamic pattern": "Total", "All (N=1,010)": len(df),
           "Long ACT": int((df["cohort_def"] == "long").sum()),
           "Short ACT": int((df["cohort_def"] == "short").sum())})
supp5 = pd.DataFrame(t5)
supp5.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "supplementary_table_5_cohort3_dynamics_patterns.csv"), index=False)
print("=" * 90)
print("SUPPLEMENTARY TABLE 5 — serial ctDNA dynamic patterns (N = 1,010)")
print("=" * 90)
print(supp5.to_string(index=False))


# ── Figure 4 (hazard ratios) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lm = landmark_prep(df)
print(f"\nLandmark-analysable cohort: n = {len(lm)}")

# Panel A: multivariable stage-adjusted HRs vs sustained-negative
A = cox_multivariate(lm)
# Panels B-E: Long vs Short within each pattern (reference = Short)
BE_PANEL = {"sustained_negative": "B", "clearance": "C", "rising": "D", "decrease_detectable": "E"}
BE = {}
for gk in BE_PANEL:
    sub = lm[lm["ctdna_dynamics"] == gk]
    L = sub[sub["cohort_def"] == "long"]; S = sub[sub["cohort_def"] == "short"]
    if len(L) >= MIN_N and len(S) >= MIN_N:
        hr, lo, hi, p = cox_binary(S["_lm_months"].values, S["_evt"].values,
                                   L["_lm_months"].values, L["_evt"].values,
                                   S["stage_num"].values, L["stage_num"].values)
    else:
        hr = lo = hi = p = np.nan
    BE[gk] = dict(hr=hr, lo=lo, hi=hi, p=p, nL=len(L), nS=len(S),
                  eL=int(L["_evt"].sum()), eS=int(S["_evt"].sum()), L=L, S=S)

# Panel F: Long-only decrease-but-detectable, TP#3 ctDNA >=median vs <median
ddl = lm[(lm["ctdna_dynamics"] == "decrease_detectable") & (lm["cohort_def"] == "long")]
med = ddl["MTM_tp2"].median()
lo_m = ddl[ddl["MTM_tp2"] < med]; hi_m = ddl[ddl["MTM_tp2"] >= med]
fhr, flo, fhi, fp = cox_binary(lo_m["_lm_months"].values, lo_m["_evt"].values,
                               hi_m["_lm_months"].values, hi_m["_evt"].values,
                               lo_m["stage_num"].values, hi_m["stage_num"].values)

# ── results table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────--
rows = []
for gk in ["clearance", "decrease_detectable", "rising"]:
    if gk in A:
        hr, lo, hi, p = A[gk]
        rows.append({"panel": "A", "comparison": f"{LABELS[gk]} vs Sustained neg (MV stage-adj)",
                     "HR": round(hr, 3), "CI_low": round(lo, 3), "CI_high": round(hi, 3),
                     "p": p, "N": int((lm["ctdna_dynamics"] == gk).sum())})
for gk, panel in BE_PANEL.items():
    d = BE[gk]
    rows.append({"panel": panel, "comparison": f"{LABELS[gk]}: Long vs Short",
                 "HR": round(d["hr"], 3) if not np.isnan(d["hr"]) else "",
                 "CI_low": round(d["lo"], 3) if not np.isnan(d["hr"]) else "",
                 "CI_high": round(d["hi"], 3) if not np.isnan(d["hr"]) else "",
                 "p": d["p"], "N": f"L{d['nL']}/S{d['nS']}"})
rows.append({"panel": "F", "comparison": "Decrease (Long only): >=median vs <median TP#3 ctDNA",
             "HR": round(fhr, 3), "CI_low": round(flo, 3), "CI_high": round(fhi, 3),
             "p": fp, "N": len(ddl)})
res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
res.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "figure_4_duration_HRs.csv"), index=False)
print("\nFIGURE 4 — hazard ratios")
with pd.option_context("display.width", 160):
    print(res.to_string(index=False))


# ── Figure 4 (panels A-F) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def fmt_hr(hr, lo, hi, p):
    return "n/a" if (hr is None or np.isnan(hr)) else f"HR={hr:.2f} ({lo:.2f}\u2013{hi:.2f}) p={fmt_p(p) or '<0.001'}"


max_t = lm["_lm_months"].max()
max_tick = int(np.ceil(max_t / 6) * 6)
xticks = list(np.arange(0, max_tick + 1, 6))
xlim = (-0.5, max_tick + 0.5)
XLAB = "Months since assessment timepoint"

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 15))
# 4 rows (km / risk / km / risk) x 3 cols; a tall blank spacer separates the two panel rows
gs = fig.add_gridspec(5, 3, height_ratios=[4.0, 1.35, 0.9, 4.0, 1.35],
                      hspace=0.18, wspace=0.18)
fig.suptitle("Figure 4. Serial ctDNA dynamics and adjuvant chemotherapy duration (DFS)",
             fontsize=15, fontweight="bold", y=0.995)


def finish_km(ax, title, ann_text, ylabel="Disease-free survival"):
    ax.set_xlim(xlim); ax.set_xticks(xticks); ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.05)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
    hide_spines(ax); ax.tick_params(labelbottom=False)
    ax.text(0.02, 0.03, ann_text, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8, va="bottom",
            family="monospace", bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", fc="white", ec="grey", alpha=0.9))
    if ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[0]:
        ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")


# Panel A — DFS by ctDNA dynamics (4 groups)
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0]); rA = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0], sharex=axA)
strataA = []
for gk in ["sustained_negative", "clearance", "decrease_detectable", "rising"]:
    sub = lm[lm["ctdna_dynamics"] == gk]
    if len(sub) >= MIN_N:
        draw_km_curve(axA, fit_km(sub["_lm_months"].values, sub["_evt"].values), COLORS[gk],
                      label=f"{LABELS[gk]} (n={len(sub)})")
        strataA.append((LABELS[gk], COLORS[gk], sub["_lm_months"].values))
txtA = [f"Sustained neg (n={int((lm['ctdna_dynamics']=='sustained_negative').sum())}): ref"]
for gk in ["clearance", "decrease_detectable", "rising"]:
    if gk in A:
        txtA.append(f"{LABELS[gk]}: {fmt_hr(*A[gk])}")
finish_km(axA, "A. DFS by ctDNA dynamics\nMultivariable stage-adjusted Cox (ref = Sustained neg)",
          "\n".join(txtA))
draw_risk_table(rA, strataA, xticks, xlim, xlabel=XLAB, fontsize=7.2)

# Panels B-E — Long vs Short within each dynamic group
pos = {"sustained_negative": (0, 1), "clearance": (0, 2), "rising": (3, 0), "decrease_detectable": (3, 1)}
for gk, (r, c) in pos.items():
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[r, c]); rx = fig.add_subplot(gs[r + 1, c], sharex=ax)
    d = BE[gk]; col = COLORS[gk]; strata = []
    if len(d["L"]) >= MIN_N:
        draw_km_curve(ax, fit_km(d["L"]["_lm_months"].values, d["L"]["_evt"].values), col, ls="-")
        strata.append(("Long", col, d["L"]["_lm_months"].values))
    if len(d["S"]) >= MIN_N:
        draw_km_curve(ax, fit_km(d["S"]["_lm_months"].values, d["S"]["_evt"].values), col, ls="--")
        strata.append(("Short", col, d["S"]["_lm_months"].values))
    finish_km(ax, f"{BE_PANEL[gk]}. {LABELS[gk]}: Long(\u2014) vs Short(--)",
              f"Long vs Short: {fmt_hr(d['hr'], d['lo'], d['hi'], d['p'])}\n"
              f"Long n={d['nL']} (ev {d['eL']}) | Short n={d['nS']} (ev {d['eS']})")
    ax.title.set_color(col)
    draw_risk_table(rx, strata, xticks, xlim, xlabel=XLAB, fontsize=7.2)

# Panel F — decrease-but-detectable (Long only), TP#3 ctDNA median split
axF = fig.add_subplot(gs[3, 2]); rF = fig.add_subplot(gs[4, 2], sharex=axF)
strataF = []
if len(lo_m) and len(hi_m):
    draw_km_curve(axF, fit_km(lo_m["_lm_months"].values, lo_m["_evt"].values), "#1B5E20", ls="-")
    draw_km_curve(axF, fit_km(hi_m["_lm_months"].values, hi_m["_evt"].values), "#008BCE", ls="-")
    strataF = [("< median", "#1B5E20", lo_m["_lm_months"].values),
               ("\u2265 median", "#008BCE", hi_m["_lm_months"].values)]
finish_km(axF, f"F. Decrease-but-detectable (Long only)\nDFS by TP#3 ctDNA (median {med:.3f})",
          f">=med vs <med: {fmt_hr(fhr, flo, fhi, fp)}\n<med n={len(lo_m)} | >=med n={len(hi_m)}")
draw_risk_table(rF, strataF, xticks, xlim, xlabel=XLAB, fontsize=7.2)

fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.95)
for ext in ("png", "pdf"):
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f"figure_4_duration_km_panels.{ext}"), dpi=200,
                bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
plt.close(fig)
print("\nSaved Figure 4 panels and all Cohort 3 outputs to:", OUT_DIR)
